watch.summary: A streamer panics as he accidentally ruins his character's pose and tries to re-blend into a wall painting before the hiding phase timer expires.

beats.what: Streamer admits he is in trouble with the hiding timer ticking down.
Accidentally opens the pose wheel and shifts his character.
Screams in distress as he forgets his original hidden pose.
Thinks he fixed it but realizes only 60 seconds remain.
Frantically figures out how to use the painting tool to cover his mistakes.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: What was the pose I had before? Oh God!
watch.why: The streamer's sudden frantic distress after messing up a simple pose creates funny high-stakes panic humor. His exaggerated screams and race against the ticking timer carry the clip well.
